generation.explanation: Completing the square turns the expression into the area of a square. Split the 6x term into two strips of area 3x each and place them along two sides of the x-by-x square; the missing corner is 3×3, so adding 9 fills the larger square: x² + 6x + 9 = (x + 3)².
